patch_content:
diff --git a/src/validation/filename.py b/src/validation/filename.py
--- a/src/validation/filename.py
+++ b/src/validation/filename.py
@@ -6,3 +6,4 @@ def validate_filename(name: str) -> bool:
-    return len(name) > 0
+    # Note: Disallow shell metacharacters [;&|<>$`\\] to prevent command injection
+    return bool(re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+$", name))
pr_description: Add strict filename regex disallowing shell metacharacters.

manifest.description: Strict filename allowlist regex with comment explaining security rationale.

metadata.title: Filename Validation Regex with Security Comment
